name: Xperia Arc

images.credit: y_k_asz, CC BY-SA 3.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Platform.Operating system: Android 2.3.3 "Gingerbread", (officially upgradeable up to Android 4.0.4 "Ice Cream Sandwich", unofficially upgradeable up to Android 6.0 "Marshmallow")
Platform.CPU: Qualcomm MSM 8255 1 GHz Scorpion (Snapdragon) Adreno 205 GPU

Memory.Card slot: Up to 32 GB on microSD memory card

Display.Display: 4.2 inch 854×480 px FWVGA "Reality Display" TFT LCD at 233 PPI with mobile BRAVIA engine, 16M Colors

Cameras.Rear camera: 8.1 MP (3264×2448), Back-illuminated sensor Exmor R CMOS Sensor, Auto Focus, Face recognition, Geo-tagging, Image and video stabilizer, Smile detection, Touch focus, Video 720p HD (Android 2.3)

Connectivity.Connectivity: Bluetooth 2.1 with A2DP, microUSB 2.0, 3.5 mm audio jack, Assisted GPS, Wi-Fi 802.11 b/g/n, HDMI (Type D connector)
